_comment: MCP Server Configuration Template for Claude Code / Claude Desktop
_usage: Copy relevant sections to ~/.claude/claude_desktop_config.json or project .claude/settings.json

setup_instructions.step_2: Install uv (Python package manager): curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
setup_instructions.step_3: Copy mcpServers config to your Claude settings file
setup_instructions.step_4: Replace /path/to/your/project with your actual project path
setup_instructions.step_5: For GitHub MCP: create a personal access token at github.com/settings/tokens
setup_instructions.step_6: Restart Claude Code / Claude Desktop to load new MCP servers
